acceptance: Red first: a fixture inbox with one delivered item shows a delivered count of 1 in the queue view.
The queue view reads its states from the inboxmover state list, and a test fails when a state of that list has no count.
fix: Count delivered/ in the dashboard queue as its own state, read through the inboxmover state list so that a later state cannot be missed again.
source: console review of PR #1841 round 2, finding M-A
summary: PR #1841 adds the inbox state delivered/ (a lane ship that waits for the integration). The dashboard queue view in go/internal/dashboard/queue.go counts the root, processing, retry and quarantine states but not delivered/, so a delivered item disappears from the dashboard until it is consumed. Round 2 of the #1841 review recorded this as finding M-A.
title: The dashboard queue counts the items in the delivered state
